name: geopolitical-perspectives
description: Geopolitical intelligence with comprehensive multi-region sources and extended timeouts

steps.name: fetch-western-perspective
steps.prompt:
Fetch Western (US/UK) news sources for major geopolitical events. Fetch feeds in PARALLEL - make all requests simultaneously, don't wait for one to finish before starting the next.

Sources to fetch:
🇺🇸 US Perspective:
- Reuters World: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/worldNews
- AP World News: https://feeds.ap.org/apnews/world  
- CNN World: https://rss.cnn.com/rss/edition_world.rss
- Washington Post World: https://feeds.washingtonpost.com/rss/world
- WSJ World: https://feeds.a.dj.com/rss/RSSWorldNews

🇬🇧 UK Perspective:
- BBC World: https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/world/rss.xml
- The Guardian World: https://feeds.theguardian.com/theguardian/world/rss
- The Times: https://www.thetimes.co.uk/rss world section if available

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously (parallel, not sequential)
2. If a feed fails after 15 seconds, skip it and continue
3. Don't retry failed feeds - just note which ones worked
4. Process all successful feeds together

Extract for each working feed:
- Top 5-7 international stories from last 24h
- Headline + 1-2 sentence summary
- Source name

Focus on: Military/security, diplomatic relations, trade/economic geopolitics, regional conflicts

Return structured list grouped by source. Note which feeds succeeded/failed.

steps.prompt:

Sources:

- Al Jazeera: https://www.aljazeera.com/xml/rss/all.xml
- Al Jazeera Middle East section focus

🇦🇪 UAE:
- Gulf News: https://gulfnews.com/rss
- The National UAE: https://www.thenationalnews.com/rss.xml

🇮🇱 Israel:
- Jerusalem Post: https://www.jpost.com/rss/
- Times of Israel: https://www.timesofisrael.com/feed/

🇹🇷 Turkey:
- Daily Sabah: https://www.dailysabah.com/rss.xml

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any that take >15s or fail. Don't retry.

Extract top 5-7 stories per working source covering:
- Israel-Palestine/Gaza developments
- Iran regional influence
- Gulf state diplomacy
- Turkey's regional role
- Energy/geopolitics

Return structured list noting which sources succeeded.

steps.name: fetch-european-perspective

Sources:

- Deutsche Welle World: https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-world
- DW Europe: https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-eu

🇫🇷 France:

- France 24 Europe: https://www.france24.com/en/europe/rss

🇳🇴 Nordic/EU:

Extract 5-7 stories per source covering:

- Russia-Ukraine coverage
- European energy security
- NATO developments
- Trade disputes

Note how European framing may differ from US on Russia, China, Middle East.

Return structured list.

🇧🇷 Latin America:
- Buenos Aires Times: https://www.batimes.com.ar/feed
- Rio Times: https://riotimesonline.com/feed/

steps.name: identify-key-events
steps.prompt:
Compare all the international coverage to identify key geopolitical stories with different regional framings.

WESTERN COVERAGE:
{{western_coverage}}

MIDDLE EAST COVERAGE:
{{me_coverage}}

EUROPEAN COVERAGE:
{{eu_coverage}}

ASIA-PACIFIC COVERAGE:
{{asia_coverage}}

GLOBAL SOUTH COVERAGE:
{{global_south_coverage}}

TASK:
1. Cross-reference all sources to find stories appearing in MULTIPLE regions
2. Identify stories covered by only ONE region (regional priorities)
3. For each key story, note different regional framings:
   - Western: Security/military focus, values framing
   - Asian: Economic/trade, sovereignty, non-interference
   - Middle East: Regional actors, religious/sectarian angles
   - Global South: Economic impacts, equity, development
4. Pick the 4-6 most significant geopolitical developments
5. Note factual differences if any (different numbers, timelines)

Return detailed analysis focused on comparative coverage - how different regions see the same events differently.

steps.name: format-geopolitical-brief
steps.prompt:
Create a Geopolitical Perspectives Brief showing how different regions cover the same events.

ANALYSIS:
{{key_events_analysis}}

SOURCE DATA:
Western: {{western_coverage}}
Middle East: {{me_coverage}}
Europe: {{eu_coverage}}
Asia: {{asia_coverage}}
Global South: {{global_south_coverage}}

FORMAT:
```
🌍 **Geopolitical Perspectives — {date}**

**🔥 Top Global Stories with Regional Framings**

**Story 1: [Headline]**
🇺🇸🇬🇧 Western angle: [How US/UK sources frame it]
🇪🇺 European angle: [EU perspective if different]
🌏 Asian angle: [China/Japan/India framing]
🌍 Middle East: [Regional perspective]
⚖️ **Key difference**: [What's emphasized differently]

**Story 2: [Next story]**
[Same format with all applicable regional angles]

**Story 3: [Third story]**
[Same format]

**📊 Coverage Patterns**
✅ **Globally covered** (most regions reported):
• [Story] — Universal significance
• [Story] — Global impact

👁️ **Regional priorities** (only 1-2 regions):
• [Story] — Covered primarily by: [regions]
• [Story] — Why others may ignore it

🚫 **Notable blind spots**:
• [Event] — Covered by [X] but NOT by [Y]
• Possible reasons: [geographic distance, bias, irrelevance]

**💡 Regional Narrative Priorities**
• **Western media**: Security/military, values, democracy framing
• **Asian media**: Economic/trade impacts, sovereignty, development
• **Middle East media**: Regional actors, Palestinian issues, Islamic perspective
• **Global South**: Economic equity, climate justice, reform demands

**🔮 Developments to Watch**
• [Emerging issue with multi-regional implications]
• [Potential flashpoint not yet widely covered]

_Sources: Reuters, BBC, Al Jazeera, CGTN, DW, + regional outlets — OpenFang Geopol Intel_
```

Make genuinely insightful. Show how regional priorities shape coverage of the same facts. Highlight blind spots and framing differences. Keep under 2000 characters.
